ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% low-intensity black/dark grey pixels versus 15% high-intensity white/light grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white markings are distributed as follows: a dense cluster of small circular spots on the left medial lobe; a series of parallel diagonal lines on the far-left distal tip; a highly distinct spiral/swirl pattern on the right distal tip; and three prominent vertical linear streaks on the right medial lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 40 degrees and a depth ratio of roughly 1:5 relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the majority of the trailing edge; two deep, high-amplitude notches are visible on the right lobe's distal boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curve along the trailing edge extending from the median notch to the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated cluster of circular high-contrast white spots located in the mid-section of the left lobe, consistent with localized scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-vertical parallel white lines (rake marks) on the right lobe; multiple thin diagonal white lines on the far left distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular notches on the upper right trailing edge suggest mechanical trauma or significant previous tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique scroll-like spiral pigmentation motif located on the right lobe near the upper-outer edge.
